description: Flexa Analytics is an advanced Power BI visual add-on designed to empower business users with Monte Carlo simulations and all the enhanced capabilities of Flexa Tables. This upgraded visual enables teams to run probabilistic forecasts, explore "what-if" scenarios, and make confident decisions under uncertainty — all without code and within Power BI's familiar interface. Simple enough for everyday users. Powerful enough for analysts. Flexa Analytics turns every report into an interactive workspace for forecasting, risk modeling, and data-driven strategy. Key Features Monte Carlo Simulation: Simulate thousands of possible outcomes to model uncertainty, forecast risk, and explore probabilities — right inside Power BI, no coding required. Quick Variance Calculations: Instantly calculate percentages, ratios, and value differences — with built-in visual feedback. Pivot Like Excel: Enable viewers and developers to pivot data and build custom views for troubleshooting or insights — even after publishing. Unlock All Hidden Data: Access all columns from the original source, even beyond what’s visible in published reports. Data Simulation Within the Table: Adjust inputs and assumptions live in the report to run what-if scenarios. Header-Based Filtering: Filter data directly from column headers — intuitive, flexible, and slicer-free. Flexa Analytics Goes Beyond Static Dashboards —…
